in_marathi.name: Rameshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rameshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rameshwar is a compound name derived from 'Rama' and 'Ishwar'. 'Rama' refers to the Hindu god Rama, an avatar of the god Vishnu. 'Ishwar' means 'God'. Thus, Rameshwar can be interpreted as 'God of Rama' or 'God who is the embodiment of Rama'.

'Rama' refers to the Hindu god Rama, an avatar of the god Vishnu. 'Ishwar' means 'God'. Thus, Rameshwar can be interpreted as 'God of Rama' or 'God who is the embodiment of Rama'.

vedic_reference.note: Rameshwar is a revered name in Hinduism, derived from the names of two gods - Rama and Ishwar. Rama is a popular deity in Hinduism and Ishwar is the supreme God. Rameshwar is considered the god who is the abode of Rama.
